description: This file defines a trait and a class for monitoring and logging the status of Kubernetes pods in a Spark application, including event handling, status logging, and watch management.

classes.name: LoggingPodStatusWatcher
classes.description: A trait defining the interface for watching and managing Kubernetes pod status updates.

classes.name: LoggingPodStatusWatcherImpl
classes.description: A class implementing the watcher for Kubernetes pod status, handling events, logging, and watch lifecycle.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state related to resource version tracking.

methods.name: eventReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming events related to pod status changes.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Handles the closure of the watcher, with or without an exception.

methods.name: logLongStatus
methods.description: Logs the current status of the pod.

methods.name: hasCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the pod has completed successfully or failed.

methods.name: closeWatch
methods.description: Closes the watch and updates internal state.

methods.name: watchOrStop
methods.description: Waits for the pod to finish or resource to become outdated, then stops watching.
